verdict.rationale: Only community comments say OneDrive has a free tier: one user mentions the free 20 GB allotment and another says it is 'free until it isn't.' First-party docs confirm that consumer OneDrive (/me/drive) uses the same Microsoft Graph API as OneDrive for Business, but none mention a free plan, its quota or its client and API parity. missing for 10: first-party published free-tier storage quota, documentation that free accounts use the same sync clients and Graph API, independent confirmation of free-tier limits.

support.subject: As a power user, I can start free — a real free tier with published storage quota that works with the same clients and API

citations.quote: the 20 gigabyte they give you for free doesn't cut it
which is free until it isn't and then they jam you with a subscription
